derivation.rationale: The centered matrix risk differentiates to B*=C_ta C_aa^-1. Completing the square gives the estimation penalty; fitted means add their explicit squared offset. prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: The construction predicts: A matrix correction should beat unit subtraction specifically when reference/downstream errors are anisotropic and correlated; its matrix component should switch off for zero cross-covariance, while any separately fitted mean correction remains. It can be rejected by: Reject if legal moment estimates are unstable across assets or any improvement disappears against fixed subtraction/diagonal correction at matched calibration budget. This contrast is specified before any new-method experiment.
